title: Schadenfreude over the abyss
text: EUvsDisinfo – analiza: Schadenfreude over the abyss. Pro-Kremlin disinformation operators have tried to smear, delegitimise and humiliate Ukraine's president Volodymyr Zelenskyy since his election in 2019. We have documented hundreds of attacks against him and other Ukrainian officials . When US President Trump and Vice President Vance publicly argued with Zelenskyy on 28 February, mouthpieces of the Kremlin and their underlings in the disinformation ecosystem unsurprisingly relished discussing the meeting in great detail . They portrayed the Ukrainian war-time leader as ‘drug-addicted’, ‘delusional’, ‘psychologically inadequate’, ‘incompetent’, ‘corrupt’ , and believe it or not, a ‘Cocaine Fuhrer’ . Insults reveal the insulter Deputy Chairman of Russia’s Security Council Dmitry Medvedev called Zelenskyy a ‘cocaine-addicted clown’ and ‘the ungrateful pig that got a hard slap from the masters of the pigsty’. RT liar-in-chief Margarita Simonyan declared that Zelenskyy had been ‘smashed, disgraced and put in his place, destroyed himself in the eyes of the American people and insulted the White House’. She concluded that ‘now he is finished, must resign, apologise … the Ukrainian delegation was raped’. Meanwhile, Russian Foreign Ministry spin doctor Maria Zakharova compared Zelenskyy to a character from a Soviet film characterised as a ‘ weak, intellectually undeveloped being’. A dream come true Russian state-controlled outlets and the pro-Kremlin disinformation ecosystem went into overdrive to blame Zelenskyy for the outcome of the meeting and portray him as disrespectful, aggressive, and a warmonger unwilling to end the conflict . President Trump, by contrast, was praised as a leader striving for ‘peace and prosperity’. The Sputnik outlet claimed Ukraine is a ‘deep state tool’ to destroy Trump. The Kremlin has long blamed NATO for its own invasion of Ukraine and dreamt about splitting the transatlantic alliance. Therefore particular emphasis was placed on driving a wedge between the US and other NATO members by claiming that the diplomatic incident had been ‘scripted by the Europeans’ and in particular the United Kingdom , who are using Ukraine to promote their anti-Russian agenda. The fact that Zelenskyy attended a summit in London directly after his visit to Washington was presented as evidence of British involvement .
